legal_combination_law: For every unordered pair below, legal combinations are the Cartesian product of the two declared domains minus the default rules and that row's rules. The violation set is generated from these rules; no survey example is normative.

model-route-coherence.legal: model_route may pair only with model_route or unknown; unknown is non-claim and is compatible with every value
model-route-coherence.forbidden: a model_route value paired with any verified harness value

no-native-pool-native-cache.legal: all domain pairs except the forbidden combination
no-native-pool-native-cache.reason: A harness without a native pool cannot also claim the native pool's cache invalidation semantics.

native-pool-no-provided-cache.legal: all domain pairs except the forbidden combination
native-pool-no-provided-cache.reason: A harness with a native pool cannot also claim ctower's provided pool cache semantics over that credential set.

no-native-pool-no-native-subagent-lease.legal: all domain pairs except the forbidden combination
no-native-pool-no-native-subagent-lease.reason: A harness without a native pool cannot claim native per-task credential leasing.

authored-config-account-file-never-both.legal: all domain pairs except the forbidden combination
authored-config-account-file-never-both.reason: An authored-config-only surface cannot simultaneously claim an account-file identity as its credential surface.

direct-cli-identity-gateway-probe-never-.legal: all domain pairs except the forbidden combination
direct-cli-identity-gateway-probe-never-.reason: A direct-CLI identity proof cannot describe a gateway endpoint probe.

gateway-device-identity-direct-probe-nev.legal: all domain pairs except the forbidden combination
gateway-device-identity-direct-probe-nev.reason: A gateway device-pairing proof cannot describe a direct-CLI endpoint probe.
